items.title: 6.3.5 Similarly, we find condition of Tangency for other parabolas (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Book p. 187-188: 6.3.5 (heading repeats the 6.3.4 sentence); unlabelled worked problem: tangent yy1 = 2a(x + x1) and normal to y^2 = 4ax at (x1, y1).

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: 6.3.5 ka chhapa hua heading darasal 6.3.4 ki aakhri line hi dohra raha hai ("Similarly, we can find condition of tangency for other parabolas"). Is heading ke neeche kitab jo cheez chhapti hai woh ek hal shuda sawal hai, jis par koi example number nahi: \(y^{2} = 4ax\) ke kisi diye gaye point \((x_{1}, y_{1})\) par tangent aur normal. Hum ise neeche alag heading ke saath pesh kar rahe hain. Us ke baad, jo heading kehta hai woh bhi (apni taraf se) dikha dete hain: baqi teen standard parabolas ke liye tangency ki shartein.

6.3.4 mein humne dekha tha ke line kab parabola ko chhooti hai. Ab ulta sawal: parabola par point diya hai, us point par tangent kaun si line hai? Yahan derivative kaam aayega: derivative batata hai ke us point par curve kitna dhalwaan hai, aur wohi dhalaan tangent ki slope hai.
Worked problem: tangent and normal at \((x_{1}, y_{1})\)

Is hal shuda sawal ke do natije (tangent aur normal) itne zaroori hain ke inhein formula ki tarah yaad kar lena chahiye. Lekin sirf ratna kaafi nahi: exam mein kabhi kabhi poocha jata hai 'derive the equation of tangent', to upar wale chaar qadam (differentiate, slope, point-slope form, \(y_{1}^{2} = 4ax_{1}\) se simplify) saaf likhne honge.

blocks.title: Worked problem
blocks.problem: Find the equations of the tangent and normal to the parabola \(y^{2} = 4ax\) at the point \((x_{1}, y_{1})\).
steps:
Diya gaya: parabola \(y^{2} = 4ax\) aur us par ek point \((x_{1}, y_{1})\), yaani \(y_{1}^{2} = 4ax_{1}\).
Maloom karna: \((x_{1}, y_{1})\) par tangent aur normal.
Tareeqa: \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) se tangent ki slope, phir point-slope form; aakhir mein \(y_{1}^{2} = 4ax_{1}\) se simplify. Normal ki slope tangent ki slope ka negative reciprocal (ulta kar ke sign badalna).

Qadam 1: Tangent ki slope
\(y^{2} = 4ax\) ko \(x\) ke lihaz se differentiate karne par
\[2y\dfrac{dy}{dx} = 4a\]
\[\Rightarrow \dfrac{dy}{dx} = \dfrac{2a}{y}\]
Is liye \((x_{1}, y_{1})\) par tangent ki slope
\[\left(\dfrac{dy}{dx}\right)_{(x_{1}, y_{1})} = \dfrac{2a}{y_{1}}\]
Kyun: yeh implicit differentiation hai; chain rule se \(\frac{d}{dx}(y^{2}) = 2y\frac{dy}{dx}\). Phir \(y\) ki jagah \(y_{1}\) rakha.
Dhyan dein: yeh \(y_{1} \ne 0\) par chalta hai; vertex par tangent vertical line \(x = 0\) hai.

Qadam 2: Point-slope form
\[y - y_{1} = \dfrac{2a}{y_{1}}(x - x_{1})\]
Dono taraf \(y_{1}\) se multiply karne par
\[yy_{1} - y_{1}^{2} = 2ax - 2ax_{1}\]
Terms ki tarteeb badalne par
\[yy_{1} - 2ax = y_{1}^{2} - 2ax_{1}\]
Kyun: \((x_{1}, y_{1})\) se guzarne wali aur slope \(m\) wali line \(y - y_{1} = m(x - x_{1})\) hoti hai; \(y_{1}\) se multiply kar ke fraction khatam kiya.

Qadam 3: Point parabola par hai, is baat ka faida
\((x_{1}, y_{1})\) parabola par hai, is liye \(y_{1}^{2} = 4ax_{1}\). Yeh value rakhne par
\[yy_{1} - 2ax = 4ax_{1} - 2ax_{1} = 2ax_{1}\]
Sab terms ek taraf
\[yy_{1} - 2ax - 2ax_{1} = 0\]
jo simplify ho kar
\[yy_{1} = 2a(x + x_{1})\]
yahi tangent ki matloob equation hai.
Kyun: \(y_{1}^{2}\) ki jagah \(4ax_{1}\) rakhne se sirf \(x_{1}, y_{1}\) ki pehli powers bachti hain, aur ek chhoti, yaad rakhne mein aasaan shakal mil jati hai.

Qadam 4: Normal
Normal ki slope tangent ki slope ka negative reciprocal hai. Is liye
\[\text{Slope of the normal} = -\dfrac{y_{1}}{2a}\]
Point-slope form se normal ki equation
\[y - y_{1} = -\dfrac{y_{1}}{2a}(x - x_{1})\]
Kyun: normal tangent par perpendicular hai, to \(m_{1}m_{2} = -1\): \(\frac{2a}{y_{1}} \times \left(-\frac{y_{1}}{2a}\right) = -1\).

Tasdeeq:
\(a = 1\) aur \(y^{2} = 4x\) par point \((1, 2)\) lein. Tangent: \(2y = 2(x + 1)\), yaani \(y = x + 1\). Ise \(y^{2} = 4x\) mein rakhein: \((x + 1)^{2} = 4x\), yaani \((x - 1)^{2} = 0\), dohra root; line \((1, 2)\) par sirf chhooti hai. 6.3.4 ki shart se bhi: \(m = 1\), \(c = \frac{a}{m} = 1\). Normal: \(y - 2 = -(x - 1)\), yaani \(x + y - 3 = 0\), slope \(-1\), jo slope 1 par perpendicular hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Tangent yaad rakhne ka aasaan qaida (hamari taraf se): curve ki equation mein \(y^{2}\) ki jagah \(yy_{1}\) aur \(x\) ki jagah \(\frac{x + x_{1}}{2}\) likh dein:
\[y^{2} = 4ax \ \to\ yy_{1} = 4a\cdot\dfrac{x + x_{1}}{2}\]
Yeh wohi qaida hai jo 6.2.2 mein circle ke liye seekha tha, aur wahan ka Note kehta hai ke yeh tamaam conics par lagta hai. Normal ko fractions ke baghair bhi likh sakte hain:
\[y_{1}x + 2ay - x_{1}y_{1} - 2ay_{1} = 0\]

Ab tak saara kaam sirf \(y^{2} = 4ax\) par hua. Heading ka kehna hai 'isi tarah doosre parabolas ke liye bhi'. To chaliye baqi teen standard forms ke natije bhi ek jagah jama kar lete hain, taake exam mein agar parabola baayen, upar ya neeche khulta ho to aap pareshan na hon. Yeh hissa kitab mein chhapa hua nahi, hamari taraf se khulasa hai; har natija aap khud bilkul 6.3.4 ki tarah nikal sakte hain.

Har standard equation mein \(y = mx + c\) rakhein aur discriminant ko zero karein (bilkul 6.3.4 ki tarah), to tangency ki shart mil jati hai; aur \((x_{1}, y_{1})\) par tangent upar wale qaide se. Neeche table mein charon ek saath hain.

blocks.caption: Hamara khulasa: charon standard parabolas ki tangency shartein aur tangents

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
\(x^{2} = 4ay\) ki shart khud nikal kar dekhte hain. \(y = mx + c\) rakhein:
\[x^{2} = 4a(mx + c)\]
\[x^{2} - 4amx - 4ac = 0\]
Barabar roots: \(D = 16a^{2}m^{2} + 16ac = 0\), yaani \(c = -am^{2}\). Misaal: \(x^{2} = 4y\) (\(a = 1\)) ko line \(y = 2x - 4\) chhooti hai: \(x^{2} - 8x + 16 = (x - 4)^{2} = 0\), point \((4, 4)\) par.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Parabola \(y^{2} = 12x\) par point \((3, 6)\) hai (check: \(36 = 36\)). Is par tangent kya hoga? (Qaide se \(6y = 6(x + 3)\), yaani \(y = x + 3\).) Aur normal? (Slope \(-\frac{6}{6} = -1\): \(x + y - 9 = 0\).)

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text: Agar parabola standard form mein na ho (jaise Exercise 6.3 ka Q9) to yeh formulas mat lagayein; di gayi equation ko differentiate karein, point par slope nikalein aur point-slope form lagayein. Agar point parameter se diya ho (Q8) to \(x_{1} = at^{2}\), \(y_{1} = 2at\) ko \(yy_{1} = 2a(x + x_{1})\) mein rakh dein.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Parabola \(y^{2} = 8x\) par \(t = 1\) wala point \((2, 4)\) hai (\(a = 2\)). Tangent qaide se:
\[4y = 4(x + 2)\]
yaani \(y = x + 2\). Shart se tasdeeq: slope \(m = 1\), \(c = \frac{a}{m} = 2\). Bilkul wohi!
Normal: slope \(-\frac{y_{1}}{2a} = -\frac{4}{4} = -1\), to \(y - 4 = -(x - 2)\), yaani \(x + y - 6 = 0\).
Dekhiye, tangent aur normal ki slopes ka product \(1 \times (-1) = -1\), jaisa perpendicular lines ke liye hona chahiye.

Ek nazar peeche: 6.3.4 mein sawal tha 'slope di hui hai, tangent kaun si?', aur jawab \(c = \frac{a}{m}\) tha. 6.3.5 mein sawal hai 'point diya hua hai, tangent kaun si?', aur jawab \(yy_{1} = 2a(x + x_{1})\) hai. Dono ek hi line ke do roop hain: point \(\left(\frac{a}{m^{2}}, \frac{2a}{m}\right)\) ko \(yy_{1} = 2a(x + x_{1})\) mein rakhein to \(y = mx + \frac{a}{m}\) hi milta hai. Is tarah dono tareeqe ek doosre ki tasdeeq bhi karte hain.

Exercise mein jaane se pehle teen sawal khud se poochiye: (1) kya point waqai parabola par hai? (2) kya parabola standard form mein hai, ya pehle differentiate karna parega? (3) normal ki slope ke liye maine fraction ulta kiya aur sign badla? In teeno ka jawab haan ho to galti ka imkaan bahut kam reh jata hai.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Tangent mein \(y_{1}^{2}\) ko \(4ax_{1}\) se na badalna; jawab sahi magar simplify nahi hota.
2. \(\frac{2a}{y_{1}}\) ko normal ki slope le lena; yeh tangent ki slope hai. Normal ki slope \(-\frac{y_{1}}{2a}\) hai.
3. Tangent \(yy_{1} = 4a(x + x_{1})\) likh dena: factor \(2a\) hai, kyun ke \(x\) ki jagah average \(\frac{x + x_{1}}{2}\) aata hai.
4. Aise point par formula lagana jo parabola par hai hi nahi. Pehle \(y_{1}^{2} = 4ax_{1}\) check karein.
